Reason codes

Every free tool response, and every paid MCP and A2A response, carries reasons: [{ code, message }]: zero or more machine-readable codes from the list below. It is empty when nothing is flagged.

Codes

CodeKindMeaning
WALLET_SANCTIONEDWarningAddress matches an entry on the sanctions list.
DOMAIN_NEWLY_REGISTERED_30DWarningDomain was registered fewer than 30 days ago.
HOSTNAME_PHISHING_LISTEDWarningHostname, or a parent domain of it, is on the phishing blocklist.
HOSTNAME_LOOKALIKEWarningHostname is a probable lookalike/typosquat of a known brand domain.
WALLET_NO_HISTORYWarningNo on-chain transfer history was found for this address on this chain.
WALLET_AGE_PARTIALIncompleteInternal transfers were not checked in time; the wallet may be older than shown.
CVE_KNOWN_EXPLOITED_KEVWarningCVE is on the known exploited vulnerabilities catalog.
IOC_FOUND_IN_THREAT_FEEDWarningIndicator has at least one matching record in the threat indicator feed.
WALLET_DELEGATEDInformationalAddress currently has an EIP-7702 delegation on this chain: its code points to a delegate contract.
IP_ABUSE_REPORTEDWarningIP address has an abuse confidence score above 0 from reports in the reporting window checked.
IP_TOR_EXIT_NODEInformationalIP address is a Tor exit node.
IP_WHITELISTEDInformationalIP address is whitelisted by the abuse-report source, which does not count its reports against it.
IP_REPORTS_SCORED_ZEROInformationalIP address has abuse reports in the reporting window checked, but its abuse confidence score is 0.
PACKAGE_REPORTED_MALICIOUSWarningPackage version is reported malicious in a public malicious-package report. Such reports can be false positives.
PACKAGE_NOT_FOUNDWarningPackage does not exist in the registry. Names that do not exist yet are often invented by AI assistants and can later be registered by attackers.
PACKAGE_VERSION_NOT_FOUNDWarningThe requested version of this package does not exist in the registry.
PACKAGE_NEW_LOOKALIKEWarningPackage was first published fewer than 30 days ago and its name looks like a popular package's name.
PACKAGE_LOOKALIKEInformationalPackage name looks like a popular package's name (a possible typosquat).
PACKAGE_NEWLY_PUBLISHEDInformationalPackage was first published fewer than 30 days ago.
PACKAGE_KNOWN_VULNERABILITIESInformationalThe version checked has known vulnerabilities in the advisory databases checked.
PACKAGE_DEPRECATEDInformationalThe version checked is marked deprecated by its publisher.
PACKAGE_INSTALL_SCRIPTSInformationalThe version checked runs scripts when it is installed (preinstall, install or postinstall).

How codes affect status

  • Warning codes make status "flagged".
  • Informational codes report a fact and never change status on their own.
  • Incomplete codes mean a check did not complete: they make status "unknown", never "flagged". A warning code alongside one still flags.
  • With no warning or incomplete code, status is "unknown" if any source needed for the answer timed out, errored or was skipped, and "no_flags" otherwise. A check that did not complete is never reported as "no_flags".

Stability

  • Codes are permanent: once shipped, a code is never removed or renamed. New codes are only added.
  • A response's message can be more specific than the meaning above (for example, it may include a count). Match on code, never on message.

Test inputs

Fixed test inputs, free for every caller, are listed on Test your integration. They return WALLET_SANCTIONED, DOMAIN_NEWLY_REGISTERED_30D, HOSTNAME_PHISHING_LISTED, WALLET_NO_HISTORY, CVE_KNOWN_EXPLOITED_KEV, IOC_FOUND_IN_THREAT_FEED, WALLET_DELEGATED, IP_ABUSE_REPORTED, PACKAGE_REPORTED_MALICIOUS and PACKAGE_NEWLY_PUBLISHED without a live lookup. No test input returns HOSTNAME_LOOKALIKE, WALLET_AGE_PARTIAL, IP_TOR_EXIT_NODE, IP_WHITELISTED, IP_REPORTS_SCORED_ZERO, PACKAGE_NOT_FOUND, PACKAGE_VERSION_NOT_FOUND, PACKAGE_NEW_LOOKALIKE, PACKAGE_LOOKALIKE, PACKAGE_KNOWN_VULNERABILITIES, PACKAGE_DEPRECATED or PACKAGE_INSTALL_SCRIPTS.

Try the checks in your browser on the playground. Endpoints, tools and test inputs: About PG1.
